capabilities: Browse the web in a tabbed panel alongside notes
Persist logins per vault between sessions
Manage bookmarks and import them from Chrome or a bookmarks HTML export
Clip the current page or selection into the vault as a Markdown note
Open web links from notes in the browser panel
extras: Desktop only (uses Electron's webview, does not work on mobile); requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or newer; logins are stored per vault in app data and do not sync between devices; Google sign-in is best effort; Windows untested; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Viewing web pages while working in Obsidian means leaving the app or using the limited core Web viewer, with no persistent logins, bookmark management or reader-mode clipping.

relations.evidence: it takes priority over the core Web viewer plugin's "Open external links" option
Import bookmarks from Chrome (in the menu or the plugin settings) asks you to pick a file

requires.name: Chrome (or another Chromium-based browser) for optional bookmark import

summary: Embedded web browser that shows tabbed web pages inside Obsidian, with persistent per-vault logins, bookmarks, Chrome bookmark import and page clipping to Markdown notes.
